title: festuca caucasica
intro: Festuca caucasica, commonly known as Caucasian fescue, is a type of grass belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Caucasus region, for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca caucasica include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting against certain infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
